Cumulative, beginner-facing, grouped by the week each term is covered (not A–Z). `/course-notes add` appends a `## Week N` section. Never delete an existing entry; a later week may add a stricter-sense note, but the original beginner anchor stays. One sentence plus a cross-reference to the week section that introduces the term.
